answer: Require every agent to lock a deposit in a shared vault before it can earn: the vault releases earnings only after a slow harbor period, and each identity must pass an independent proof-of-work check bound to a sable hardware key. A sybil operator pays the full deposit plus the work cost per fake identity, and slashing burns the deposit if peers catch duplicated work — so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 deposits, not one.
